findings.detail: B01 counted 210 leaves for the 2023-03-31 review even though the source has a distinct comparative December 31, 2022 schedule block alongside the March 31, 2023 schedule.

rationale: B01 reports only 111 of 210 leaves with fair_value for the March 31, 2023 review. The raw source has a complete March schedule whose total investments fair value is 1,080,322,297, tying to the fair-value hierarchy total of 1,080,322 in thousands. It also has a separate comparative schedule block with December totals of 1,140,779,575. The low coverage therefore reflects comparative-period schedule rows leaking into the March holdings population, not missing source fair-value disclosure.
